$schema_note: Machine-readable export of the cost-quality Pareto frontier computed from arena.ai (LMArena) WebDev leaderboards. Question it answers: for a minimum acceptable Arena Score T, which model has the lowest measured cost per task? Humans: see https://modelprice.damolabs.dev/ ; interactive tool: https://modelprice.damolabs.dev/

meta.name: Arena WebDev Cost-Quality Frontier

sources.prices: each vendor's first-party API list price (verified vs benchr.org/pricing 2026-09-11 snapshot)

meta.attribution: Leaderboard data © LMArena (arena.ai). This export reproduces publicly listed scores and costs with added analysis.
meta.cost_basis: Cost/Task (P50) = median measured token usage of an Arena task x the vendor's list price (cache-miss basis; no cache discount applied).
disclaimers: Scores are a 2026-11-11 snapshot; prices are checked as of 2026-11-14 and change over time.
P50 task cost excludes long-tail (P95 can be 5-10x), latency, retries and non-token fees.
Price events below adjust list prices for verified time dependencies; uncertain rules are listed but flagged.
Cache model: cache read price stored as a ratio of input price; write multiplier 1.25x for Anthropic/OpenAI (Claude*/GPT-*) models, 1.0x otherwise.

price_events.name: DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing
price_events.rule: Peak = weekdays 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC (2x); all other hours incl. weekends 0.5x
price_events.source: DeepSeek official pricing page + 4 independent sources

price_events.name: GLM-5.3-Flash launch promo expired
price_events.rule: Before 2026-09-09: $0.05/$0.18; on/after: $0.15/$0.50 (~2.95x). The 2026-11-11 board still lists the promo price.
price_events.source: benchr.org/pricing (2026-09-11 snapshot, states promo end date)

price_events.name: Gemini 4 Carbon/Argon price hike on 2026-12-01 (announced)
price_events.source: Google Gemini API pricing page (3 independent indexes agree)

price_events.name: Whether DeepSeek V4-Flash also splits peak/off-peak
price_events.rule: Unverified; V4-Flash is retired. Off by default (sensitivity analysis only).

price_events.name: Two models 2x off vs a third-party index, no promo explanation
price_events.rule: Mistral Medium 3.5 ($0.75/$3.75 vs index $1.50/$7.50) and GPT-6 Sol ($1/$5 vs $2/$10). Off by default.

cache_model.write_multiplier_rule: 1.25 if model name starts with 'Claude' or 'GPT-', else 1.0

leaderboards.title: WebDev · Overall (open-source only)
leaderboards.frontier_method: C(T) = min{cost : score >= T}; a model joins the frontier only if strictly cheaper than every higher-scoring model. Computed over ALL models with published Cost/Task (no vote/preliminary/AutoEval filters applied). reigns_score_range = the T interval this model wins; floor of the cheapest tier = dataset min score.
